stem:
Aditi grows three similar pots. Pot 1 gets sunlight and water. Pot 2 gets sunlight but no water. Pot 3 gets water but no sunlight.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Pot 1 grows best because the plant has both sunlight and adequate water.
Pot 2 grows poorly compared with Pot 1 because it lacks water.
Pot 3 grows as well as Pot 1 because water alone is enough.

teacher.key_rationale: Best growth needs both sunlight and water. Pot 2 lacks water so grows poorly. Water alone does not match Pot 1, so statement 3 is false.
